# English Mastered

> English Mastered is a one-to-one online English coaching service founded
> by Jana Malas, a Lebanese ESL coach and native Arabic speaker. She
> specialises in coaching Arabic-speaking students and professionals in
> IELTS preparation, TOEFL preparation, Business English, English for
> Specific Purposes (ESP), and conversational fluency. All sessions are
> delivered online via video call to students in Lebanon, the Gulf, and
> worldwide.

## About Jana Malas

Jana Malas founded English Mastered in 2021 after over five years teaching
English in secondary schools, universities, and NGOs across Lebanon and
Turkey. Her native Arabic fluency gives her a perspective that native
English-speaking tutors cannot offer — she has lived the same learning
journey her students are on. She knows the sound patterns, word order
instincts, and grammar habits that Arabic speakers default to, and builds
every lesson around correcting those specific challenges.

## Services

- General English (all-round skills: speaking, listening, reading, writing)
- IELTS preparation (band-score exam coaching across all four components)
- TOEFL preparation (university and visa exam prep)
- Business English (meetings, email, and presentations)
- English for Specific Purposes / ESP (field-specific: maritime, medical, legal, aviation)
- Conversation and Fluency (natural speaking without freezing up)
- Free discovery call (15-minute level check and goal-setting, no cost)

## Pricing

- Single lesson: $15 per 60-minute one-to-one session
- 5-lesson package: $65–$70 depending on payment method
- 10-lesson package: $115–$125 depending on payment method
- All lessons are one-to-one, online, with no contracts

## Levels

English Mastered teaches all CEFR levels from A1 (beginner) through C2
(proficiency). A free AI-powered English level test is available on the
website to estimate your CEFR level before booking.

## Key differentiator

Jana is a native Arabic speaker coaching Arabic-speaking students. She
understands the specific errors, gaps, and pronunciation challenges that
Arabic speakers face when learning English — from definite article usage
to verb conjugation patterns to sounds like /p/ and /v/ that do not exist
in Arabic — because she has experienced them herself.

## Target students

Arabic-speaking professionals and students in Lebanon, the Gulf (UAE,
Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait), Jordan, Egypt, and internationally.
Students preparing for IELTS or TOEFL. Professionals who need English
for work, job interviews, or international business. Anyone who has
studied English for years but still freezes when they need to use it.
